description.value: The study examined the effect of insulin sensitivity on appetitive brain responses to visual food cues during glucose and water challenges in women with polycystic ovary syndrome using functional magnetic resonance imaging.

spans.text: Subjects ( n =19) were imaged while viewing pictures of high calorie (HC) foods and low calorie (LC) foods after ingesting either 75 g glucose or an equivalent volume of water.

value: We postulated that a glucose challenge would reduce appetitive brain responses, but this response would be compromised in insulin resistant subjects.
We conclude the PCOS women with insulin resistance have an impaired brain response to a glucose challenge.
